Custom Values

Custom values are like personalized settings that you can adjust to make your experience with our snapshot uniquely yours. They give you the power to tailor how the snapshot behaves, ensuring it fits your needs perfectly. Whether it's tweaking configurations or fine-tuning outputs, custom values empower you to make the snapshot work just the way you want it to.

If you go to Settings, then Custom Values, you will see the values we have for you. For each value, you can simply click the three dots on the side of each section to add your own value to the custom values.

Whatever you add to these values will update the entire snapshot with that information, whether it pertains to your website, funnels, automations, emails, and more.

Your Plumber Custom Values:

Customer Referral Campaign Offer: Input the offer for your referral campaign. This will integrate into your referral offer workflow.

DR Campaign Offer: Add the offer for your DR (Direct Response) campaign. This will automatically update within your DR campaign workflow.

Funnel Offer: The "2 step opt-in funnel" currently lacks an offer. Update this value to include an offer for that specific funnel.

Google Review Link (Continuous Reputation Management): Insert the Google review link for your plumbing business. This link will facilitate continuous reputation management automation.

Google Review Link (Review Campaign): This is where you'll add the plumbing business's review link, which will be the same as the one mentioned above.

Holiday Email Offer: Customize the offer you wish to run within the 13 beautifully designed holiday emails.

Plumber Consultation Calendar Link: Add your plumber consultation calendar link here. It will be utilized in certain automations.

Service Area: Specify the service area for your plumbing business.

2. Pipelines

Understanding Sales Pipelines

A sales pipeline is a visual representation of the stages a prospect goes through during the sales process, from initial contact to closing the deal. It helps businesses track and manage their sales activities, allowing them to identify bottlenecks, prioritize leads, and optimize their sales efforts effectively.

Snapshot Pipelines

In our snapshot, you'll find three distinct pipelines tailored to streamline your sales processes:

DR Campaign Pipeline: This pipeline is designed specifically for managing leads generated from your DR (Direct Response) campaigns. It helps you track and nurture these leads through the various stages of the sales cycle until they convert into customers.

Review Campaign Pipeline:The review campaign pipeline allows you to see all of your review requests that were sent through your review campaign, allowing you to see how many left a review versus those who didn't.

Main Plumber Leads Pipeline: The main plumber leads pipeline serves as the central hub for managing all your plumbing-related leads. Whether they come from website forms, web chats, or other sources, this pipeline enables you to organize, track, and prioritize these leads effectively to maximize conversion opportunities.

With these three automated pipelines at your disposal, you can efficiently manage your sales activities, nurture leads, and drive revenue growth for your plumbing business.

3. Calendars

Understanding Automated Calendars

Automated calendars are powerful tools that streamline scheduling processes, improve organization, and enhance productivity for businesses. They automate the process of booking appointments, managing service schedules, and coordinating activities, allowing businesses to efficiently allocate resources and provide exceptional service to their customers.

Snapshot Automated Calendars

In the plumber snapshot, you'll find two specialized automated calendars designed to simplify scheduling and streamline customer interactions:

Maintenance/Service Calendar: This calendar is dedicated to managing maintenance and service appointments for your plumbing business. It allows you to schedule routine maintenance tasks, service calls, and repairs efficiently, ensuring timely and reliable service delivery to your customers.

Plumber Consultation Calendar: The plumber consultation calendar is specifically tailored to handle consultations with new leads and potential customers. Anyone who books an appointment on this calendar will be automatically updated in the plumber sales pipeline, enabling seamless lead management and nurturing processes.

Appointment Confirmation, Reminders, no-show, & Cancellation Automation

Understanding Appointment Automation

Automated appointment management systems streamline the process of scheduling, confirming, and managing appointments for businesses. By leveraging automation, businesses can enhance efficiency, improve customer communication, and reduce no-show rates, ultimately maximizing productivity and customer satisfaction.

Snapshot Appointment Automation

In the plumber snapshot, we offer comprehensive automation for appointment confirmation, reminders, no-shows, and cancellations. Here's how it works:

Appointment Confirmation: When someone books an appointment on either calendar, they will receive an automated confirmation email or text message, ensuring that their appointment is successfully scheduled and confirmed.

Appointment Reminders: Prior to the scheduled appointment, automated reminders will be sent to the customer to minimize the risk of no-shows and ensure that they are prepared and ready for their appointment.

No-show Management: In the event of a no-show, the system will automatically tag the customer accordingly, allowing you to follow up and reschedule as needed to minimize disruptions to your schedule and workflow.

Cancellation Handling: If a customer cancels their appointment, the system will update their status accordingly. For example, on the Plumber Consultation Calendar, if they book an appointment, they will be updated as "appointment booked" in the pipeline. If they cancel, their status will be updated to "canceled," and if they fail to show up for the appointment, they will be marked as "no show" in the pipeline.

5. Link Trees

Understanding Link Trees

Link trees are an innovative tool designed to optimize the user experience by consolidating multiple links into a single, easily accessible webpage. They serve as a centralized hub for directing traffic to various destinations such as websites, social media profiles, contact forms, and more. Link trees are particularly beneficial for businesses as they simplify navigation, increase engagement, and improve conversion rates.

Snapshot Plumber Link Trees

In our snapshot, you'll discover four specialized plumber link trees, each offering unique functionalities tailored to enhance your online presence and streamline customer interactions:

Calendar Link Tree: This link tree provides a convenient way for customers to access your plumber consultation calendar. Whether they're scheduling appointments or requesting quotes, the calendar link tree ensures seamless booking experiences, helping you efficiently manage your appointments and maximize customer satisfaction.

Christmas Link Tree: The Christmas link tree is perfect for spreading holiday cheer and promoting seasonal offers or events. Customize this link tree with festive graphics, special discounts, or holiday-themed messages to captivate your audience and drive engagement during the festive season.

Contact Us Link Tree: Simplify communication with your customers using the contact us link tree. By consolidating essential contact information, such as phone numbers, email addresses, and physical addresses, into a single webpage, this link tree makes it effortless for visitors to reach out to your plumbing business for inquiries, support, or service requests.

Video Link Tree: Engage your audience with compelling visual content using the video link tree. Showcase informative tutorials, customer testimonials, or behind-the-scenes footage to showcase your expertise, build trust with potential customers, and differentiate your plumbing business from competitors.

Benefits of Plumber Link Trees

Enhanced Accessibility: By centralizing important links in one location, link trees make it easier for customers to find the information they need, ultimately improving user experience and satisfaction.

Increased Engagement: Customizable link trees allow you to tailor your messaging and visuals to resonate with your target audience, increasing engagement and driving conversions.

Streamlined Communication: With dedicated link trees for specific purposes such as scheduling appointments or contacting support, you can streamline communication channels and effectively manage customer inquiries and requests.

With these four plumber link trees at your disposal, you can leverage the power of centralized navigation, personalized messaging, and engaging visual content to enhance your online presence and drive business growth. Explore the customization options and unleash the full potential of link trees in your plumbing business with our snapshot!

6. Funnels

Understanding Plumber Funnels

Plumber funnels are strategic marketing pathways designed to attract, engage, and convert potential customers into leads or clients for plumbing services. These funnels guide prospects through a series of steps, from initial awareness to taking action, ultimately driving them towards booking a service or making a purchase. In our snapshot, you'll find four specialized plumber funnels tailored to address different marketing objectives and customer needs.

Snapshot Plumber Funnels

24/7 Emergency Plumbing Service Funnel: This funnel is designed to cater to customers in need of urgent plumbing assistance. It provides a seamless process for customers to request emergency plumbing services at any time of day or night, ensuring prompt response and resolution of plumbing emergencies.

Plumber $50 Coupon Funnel: The $50 coupon funnel offers an irresistible incentive for customers to avail themselves of your plumbing services. By providing a $50 discount coupon applicable to any plumbing service, this funnel encourages customers to take action and schedule a service appointment, boosting conversions and driving revenue for your plumbing business.

Plumber VSL (Video Sales Letter) Funnel: The Plumber VSL funnel leverages the power of video content to engage and persuade potential customers. This funnel allows you to customize the offer by adding it using a custom value called "funnel offer." Whether it's promoting a special discount, highlighting unique service offerings, or showcasing customer testimonials, the Plumber VSL funnel effectively communicates your value proposition and drives conversions through compelling video content.

Plumber 2 Step Opt-In Funnel: The Plumber 2 Step Opt-In funnel is designed to capture leads and build your email list effectively. Similar to the Plumber VSL funnel, you can customize the offer by adding it using a custom value called "funnel offer." By offering valuable content or incentives in exchange for contact information, such as a free guide or consultation, this funnel encourages prospects to take the first step towards becoming customers, nurturing them through the sales process and increasing conversion opportunities.

Funnel Automations:

Each funnel will be fully automated, with the name of each automation matching the corresponding funnel. Similarly, the funnel forms will be named identically for easy organization. When someone opts into a funnel, they will be seamlessly updated in the sales pipeline, tagged appropriately, and trigger an internal notification for you. Additionally, the lead will receive a personalized text and email with their offer upon opting in. If they proceed to book an appointment through the funnel, the appointment reminder automations will be triggered.

It's important to note that each automation and text message can be easily customized to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a cohesive and personalized experience for your leads.

7. 52 Week Nurture Campaigns

In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive 52-week email and text plumber nurture campaigns designed to cultivate relationships with your leads and keep your plumbing business top-of-mind. Here's what you can expect:

Benefits of Plumber Nurture Campaigns

Increased Engagement: Regular communication through emails and text messages keeps your plumbing business top-of-mind and encourages ongoing interaction with your leads, increasing engagement and retention rates.

Customizable Content: You have the flexibility to customize the content of both the emails and text messages to align with your branding, messaging, and marketing objectives. Whether it's sharing educational content, promoting special offers, or inviting leads to events, you can tailor the campaigns to suit your unique business needs.

With our 52-week email and text plumber nurture campaigns, you can stay connected with your leads, provide them with valuable insights and offers, and nurture them towards conversion over the long term.

8. Database Reactivation

Understanding Database Reactivation Campaigns

Database reactivation campaigns are strategic marketing initiatives aimed at re-engaging with inactive or lapsed leads in your database. These campaigns help revitalize your contact list, rekindle interest in your products or services, and ultimately drive conversions. In our snapshot, we offer two types of database reactivation campaigns: a basic version and an advanced version, each offering unique features and functionalities.

Snapshot Database Reactivation Campaigns

Basic Database Reactivation Campaign: The basic campaign provides a straightforward approach to reactivating dormant leads in your database. You have the flexibility to customize the offer for this campaign using a custom value. This campaign aims to reconnect with inactive leads, remind them of your value proposition, and encourage them to re-engage with your business.

Advanced Database Reactivation Campaign (DR Campaign): The advanced campaign takes database reactivation to the next level by incorporating dynamic lead management features. Similar to the basic campaign, you can customize the offer using a custom value. However, this campaign goes a step further by updating leads in a dedicated DR campaign pipeline. If a lead responds positively to the campaign, they will be moved to a "responded" status in the pipeline, indicating active interest. Conversely, if they indicate disinterest, they will be moved to a "not interested" status, allowing you to focus your efforts on more promising leads.

10. Referral Campaign Workflow

Referral campaigns are powerful marketing strategies designed to leverage the existing customer base to acquire new customers. By incentivizing customers to refer friends, family, or colleagues to your business, referral campaigns can rapidly expand your customer network and drive growth. In our snapshot, we offer a comprehensive referral campaign feature that enables you to easily create and manage referral programs tailored to your business needs.

Snapshot Referral Campaign

Customizable Referral Incentives: Our referral campaign feature allows you to customize the incentives offered to customers for referring new business. By utilizing custom values, you can tailor the incentives to align with your promotional strategies and budget. Whether it's offering discounts, freebies, or exclusive rewards, the referral campaign feature empowers you to create compelling incentives that motivate customers to spread the word about your business.

Benefits of Referral Campaigns

Expanded Customer Base: Referral campaigns tap into the power of word-of-mouth marketing to attract new customers. By leveraging the networks of your existing customers, you can rapidly expand your customer base and drive growth for your business.

Enhanced Trust and Credibility: Recommendations from friends or family members are highly trusted by consumers. By encouraging referrals, you can capitalize on this trust and credibility to attract high-quality leads and convert them into loyal customers.

Cost-Effective Marketing: Referral campaigns are a cost-effective way to acquire new customers compared to traditional advertising channels. Since referrals come from satisfied customers, the cost per acquisition is typically lower, resulting in a higher return on investment.

With our customizable referral campaign feature, you can harness the power of word-of-mouth marketing to drive growth and success for your business.

11. Incoming Lead Follow Up Workflows

Incoming lead follow-up workflows are automated processes designed to promptly respond to inquiries and messages from potential customers across various communication channels. These workflows ensure that every lead receives a timely and personalized response, increasing the chances of conversion and providing exceptional customer service. In our snapshot, we offer four incoming lead follow-up workflows tailored to different communication channels: Google My Business (GMB) message, email, Facebook message, and Instagram direct message (DM).

Snapshot Incoming Lead Follow-Up Workflows

GMB Message Workflow: This workflow is triggered when someone sends a message through your Google My Business listing. The workflow automatically tags the lead, updates their status in the pipeline as responded to, and notifies the plumber. You can easily customize the messaging and actions of this workflow to suit your preferences and brand voice.

Email Workflow: The email workflow is activated when a lead reaches out via email. Similar to the GMB message workflow, it tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the plumber, ensuring a prompt and efficient response to email inquiries.

Facebook Message Workflow: When a potential customer sends a message to your Facebook page, the Facebook message workflow springs into action. It tags the lead, updates their status, and alerts the plumber, enabling seamless communication and follow-up through Facebook Messenger.

Instagram DM Workflow: The Instagram DM workflow handles incoming direct messages on your Instagram account. It automatically tags the lead, updates their status, and notifies the plumber, facilitating quick and effective engagement with potential customers on Instagram.

With our incoming lead follow-up workflows, you can effectively manage inquiries and messages across multiple communication channels, providing timely and personalized responses to potential customers.

12. Reputation Management

Reputation management is crucial for maintaining a positive image and credibility for your plumbing business. It involves actively monitoring and influencing how your brand is perceived by customers, both online and offline. In our snapshot, we offer comprehensive reputation management features to help you proactively manage and enhance your online reputation.

Snapshot Reputation Management Features

Ongoing Reputation Management: After each service, customers have the option to request a review. This process allows you to gather feedback and testimonials from satisfied customers, helping to boost your online reputation and credibility.

Google Review Campaign: Our Google review campaign is designed to generate a significant number of new reviews for your plumbing business. You can input a list of existing customers into the campaign to kickstart the process, resulting in 30-100 new reviews right away. Customers in this campaign are managed through a dedicated review campaign pipeline, allowing you to track who has left a review and who hasn't.

Key Features and Customization Options

Custom Review Links: The review link for both ongoing reputation management and the Google review campaign can be customized using custom values. This allows you to tailor the review links to your branding and preferences.

Trigger Links: Each campaign includes two trigger links that serve as indicators of customer engagement. These trigger links, associated with the review custom value links, help you track whether customers have clicked on the review links or not, if clicked they will no longer get review reminders and so on.

13. Invoice Reminders, Cancellation, & Refunds

Automation for invoice management streamlines the process of handling invoices, reminders, cancellations, and refunds, ensuring smooth and efficient financial transactions for your plumbing business. These automated workflows help you stay organized, reduce administrative burden, and provide a seamless experience for your customers.

Snapshot Automation for Invoice Management

Invoice Reminders Automation: This automation sends timely reminders to customers who have outstanding invoices, prompting them to make payment. By automating invoice reminders, you can minimize late payments, improve cash flow, and maintain positive relationships with your customers.

Cancellation Automation: When a customer cancels a service or appointment, this automation ensures that the cancellation process is handled smoothly and efficiently. It updates the customer's status, triggers any necessary refunds, and notifies relevant stakeholders, allowing you to manage cancellations with ease and professionalism.

Refunds Automation: In cases where refunds are warranted, this automation handles the refund process seamlessly. It initiates the refund, updates the customer's status accordingly, and provides notifications to both the customer and your team, ensuring transparency and accountability in the refund process.

Key Features and Customization Options

Timely Notifications: Each automation sends timely notifications to customers and stakeholders, keeping them informed throughout the invoicing, cancellation, and refund processes.

Customizable Messaging: You have the flexibility to customize the messaging of each automation to align with your branding and communication style, ensuring a consistent and professional experience for your customers.

14. Missed Call Text Back

The Missed Call Text Back Automation is a proactive response system designed to engage with potential leads who have attempted to contact your plumbing business but were unable to connect via phone. This automation sends a text message to the missed caller, providing them with an opportunity to book a consultation or appointment with your business. By leveraging this automation, you can effectively follow up with missed leads and encourage them to take the next step towards becoming customers.

Snapshot Missed Call Text Back Automation

Engagement Text Message: When a call goes unanswered or is missed, the automation triggers a text message to be sent to the caller's phone number. The message is crafted to be engaging and inviting, encouraging the caller to consider booking a consultation or appointment with your plumbing business.

Call to Action: The text message includes a clear call to action, such as a link to your online booking system or a phone number to call back, making it easy for the recipient to take immediate action and schedule a consultation.

Personalization: To enhance engagement and relevance, the text message can be personalized with the caller's name or other relevant details, creating a more personalized and tailored experience for the recipient.
